name: NB2-MedVLM-R1

models.D: redlessone/DermLIP_ViT-B-16 (ISIC exploratory, conditional on access/license/exposure audit)

primary: B.J minus G.J, separately per dataset
secondary: B.J minus F, reported independently of primary gate

text.ensemble: unit normalize the mean of raw embeddings from both existing fixed domain templates
text.negative_control: cyclic shift in sorted seen-class IDs

generic_reuse: old per-stage aggregate banks and P weights; new J/readouts derived without fit-image forwards; old results never overwritten
medical_training_access: current class images only, independent parent runs; no old/future feature cache
validation: all core and extension states locked before val; private APART validation features reused per parent; native VLM validation features shared across parents

bootstrap.interval: conditional on the three fixed parent/order runs

user_override: Ignore all time limits and time-based cutoffs in supplied plan; execute fixed extensions after G/B core fits. No hyperparameter search or neural training authorized.
